Hey, if we haven’t met yet, my name’s Dalen. I own @outheback , a surf brand I’m building from the ground up here in South Florida. Most days I’m juggling the business, chasing waves, and figuring things out as I go, and I’ve learned a lot along the way.

This one came to me on my run this morning. The thoughts you let live in your head end up shaping who you become. What you tell yourself every day turns into how you show up, how you work, and what you build. Guard your mind like it’s your most valuable asset, because it is.

I’m starting to share more of this stuff because I want to give real, incremental value on this silly app. Not just highlight reels, but the lessons and mindset that actually move the needle in business and life. If that’s something you’re into, follow along. Let’s grow together.
